## Summary

I've successfully added two methods to the `Ledger` class:

1. **`post_end_of_day(account, amount, day: date) -> Entry`**: Posts an entry at 23:59:59 UTC on the specified date. It uses `datetime.combine()` to create a timezone-aware UTC datetime and delegates to the existing `post()` method.

2. **`entries_since(since: datetime) -> list[Entry]`**: Returns all entries posted at or after the given datetime, sorted by timestamp (oldest first). This ensures chronological ordering regardless of the order entries were added to the ledger.

Both methods follow the existing code patterns (timezone-aware UTC, proper use of Money type) and maintain backward compatibility. All 4 existing tests continue to pass.
